verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only generic AI-marketing claims (running 'the latest AI models locally', ComfyUI workflows, ollama/PyTorch support) but never states the RTX 5070 Ti's actual VRAM capacity or memory bandwidth, nor any claim about running 70B-class quantized models specifically. Without published VRAM/bandwidth specs or any benchmark showing 70B-class inference feasibility, the story's core claim is unsupported by the evidence pack.
